## Symptom
The nightly digest job fails at its first query and succeeds when it is run later in the morning (run:fixture-org/inkwell/6604817352, issue:fixture-org/inkwell#18).

## Root cause
The weekly reset of the store branch issued a new login for the job's role, and the job still held the secret synced a week earlier (issue:fixture-org/inkwell#18). Its connection was refused in 212 ms with an authentication failure while the compute had been awake for two minutes (run:fixture-org/inkwell/6604817352).

The store was not waking in this run, and the 30 s connect timeout was never reached (run:fixture-org/inkwell/6604817352).

## Fix / workaround
Sync the job's secret whenever the branch reset runs. After a sync with no code change and no deploy, the job succeeded (issue:fixture-org/inkwell#18).

## How it is caught
The connection error tells the two apart: an authentication failure that returns in milliseconds is a stale secret, not a slow resume (run:fixture-org/inkwell/6604817352).
